status: Approved small mockup; not approved for gameplay replacement
coordinates: Logical stage pixels from top-left; x right, y down. Common feet registration64,104 and72px body. Transparent source PNGs are preserved and composed by source rectangle and draw transform, with nearest-neighbor sampling.
coverage: One standing frame per direction per hero. Mirror complete composition and anchors for left. No run/jump/recoil production yet.
layers: Deliver weapon-free body plus separate back arm, weapon, and front hand/arm as needed. Order bottom-to-top explicitly per pose. Do not label combined hero+weapon art as modular.
anchor_note: Example grip/support/muzzle numbers illustrate format only. Art must measure actual positions in logical 128x128 coordinates. Registration [64,104] is fixed. No per-pose autoscaling.
acceptance: Six complete poses, correct exclusive weapons, genuine separate weapon layers.
Stable feet and body size, visible hands contacting weapon, correct layer order.
No baked-in second gun, clipped raised muzzle, detached hands, or fringe.
Mirrored anchors match mirrored pixels. Source originals and prompts preserved.
preview: Engineering composes source regions non-destructively in an HTML canvas with layer toggles, mirrored poses and final anchor overlays. Art mockup only, not running-game screenshots.

layer_transform.source_rect: [x,y,width,height] original PNG pixels; default entire image
layer_transform.destination: [x,y,width,height] logical stage pixels before rotation; default [0,0,128,128]
layer_transform.rotation_degrees: Clockwise in y-down canvas; default0. Existing weapon rotations are provisional for alignment only.
layer_transform.order: translate(pivot), rotate, translate(-pivot), draw source_rect into destination
